newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.7 bln of bonds due 2002.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.7 bln of bonds due 2002.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on February 26 C$2.7 billion of bonds with an unspecified coupon and maturing on September 1, 2002.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on March 3, pay interest on September 1 and March 1, the government said.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to redeem C$3.4 billion of government bonds maturing March 1, 1997.
The Bank of Canada said it holds C$101 million of the maturing bonds and will acquire a minimum of C$405 million of the new bonds.
